name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
description: A mutual NDA allowing two parties to disclose confidential information to each other in connection with a stated purpose, with standard confidentiality, exceptions, and term provisions.

name: Cloud Service Agreement
description: A SaaS/cloud services agreement covering access and use of a cloud product, support, data privacy and security, payment, term and termination, warranties, liability, indemnification, and confidentiality.

name: Design Partner Agreement
description: An agreement for early access/design partner programs, granting a partner early product access in exchange for feedback, with IP, confidentiality, and termination terms.

name: Service Level Agreement
description: A standalone SLA defining uptime and support response time targets, how they are calculated, and the service credits or termination rights available if targets are missed.

name: Professional Services Agreement
description: A master services agreement for statement-of-work-based professional services, covering deliverables, IP assignment, payment, warranties, liability, insurance, and confidentiality.

name: Data Processing Agreement
description: A DPA governing the processing of personal data between a controller/processor and a processor/subprocessor, including subprocessors, international data transfers (EEA SCCs/UK Addendum), security incidents, audits, and deletion.

name: Software License Agreement
description: An on-premise/installed software license agreement covering license grant, restrictions, updates, open source software, warranties, liability, indemnification, and confidentiality.

name: Partnership Agreement
description: A general business partnership/co-marketing agreement covering mutual obligations, fees, trademark licensing, privacy, dispute escalation, warranties, liability, and confidentiality.

name: Business Associate Agreement
description: A HIPAA business associate agreement covering permitted uses and disclosures of protected health information (PHI), safeguards, subcontractors, breach notification, and term/termination.

name: Pilot Agreement
description: A short-term pilot/evaluation agreement granting a prospective customer trial access to a product for evaluation purposes, with limited warranties, liability caps, and confidentiality.

name: AI Addendum
description: An addendum supplementing an underlying agreement to govern the use of AI/ML features, including input/output ownership, model training restrictions, and AI-specific disclaimers.
